items.en_title: Barra Bonita (SP) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 4 #00003
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Barra Bonita (SP) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 238,750; proposals close Dec 4, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
